blocks.text: The 52nd Metro Manila Film Festival (MMFF) will introduce the PlayTime Most Anticipated Award, a new recognition that will give Filipino moviegoers the chance to vote for the festival entry they are most excited to watch. The award was announced as the MMFF formalized its partnership with PlayTime Entertainment, which is now the festival’s Official Entertainment Partner, during a ceremony at the Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) office. Under the new award, audiences can vote for their preferred entry for free through playtime.ph/vote/mmff.
